ideas.pitch: Real-time edge telemetry system mounted on an RC car to measure slip angles, tire temperatures, and lateral G-forces during high-speed drifting and cornering.
ideas.problem_statement: Techkriti Grand Prix '27 RC car competition focusing on precision, control, and strategy on a challenging track.
ideas.title: AeroSlip: RC Telemetry and Slip-Angle Estimation System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical hardware metrics with an edge-computing setup similar to winning IoT and robotics projects, giving judges clear quantitative data on vehicle performance rather than just raw speed.

ideas.pitch: An onboard camera and lightweight micro-controller unit that records track runs and computes the optimal racing line using offline heuristic path-planning.
ideas.problem_statement: Techkriti Grand Prix '27 RC car competition requiring precision, control, and strategy on the racing track.
ideas.title: PitStop-AI: Computer Vision Track Line-Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the hardware-plus-coding requirement explicitly stated in the competition introduction while delivering a live, working demo of autonomous trajectory tuning.

ideas.pitch: A wireless telemetry module feeding real-time cell voltage, current draw, and motor temperature to a pit crew dashboard to prevent thermal throttling.
ideas.problem_statement: Techkriti Grand Prix '27 RC car competition featuring electric and nitro categories where strategy and control matter.
ideas.title: VoltGuard: Live Battery & Thermal Telemetry for Electric RC Cars
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the reliability and strategy aspects of endurance racing, showing judges a practical engineering safety system that directly prevents race-ending failures.

ideas.pitch: An RFID and IR-beam track-side gate system that feeds instant lap times and sector splits to a central dashboard without manual stopwatch errors.
ideas.problem_statement: Techkriti Grand Prix '27 RC car competition featuring head-to-head racing where split-second strategy decides the winner.
ideas.title: ApexLap: Automated Lap Counter and Sector Split Timer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an infrastructural need for the competition arena itself, creating an instant live demo that all competitors and judges can immediately use and appreciate.

ideas.pitch: A compact thermocouple and optical RPM sensor setup optimized for nitro-methanol engines to track tuning parameters live during practice runs.
ideas.problem_statement: Techkriti Grand Prix '27 RC car competition with a specific Nitro vehicle category requiring deep engineering expertise.
ideas.title: NitroSync: Exhaust Temperature & RPM Logger for Nitro RC Cars
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the nitro category specifically with hard engineering instrumentation, filling a major technical gap that standard hobbyist builds ignore.
